ref.substituent_description: Left benzene (circle) is para-disubstituted: AcNH at C1 and S(=O)2 at C4. The sulfonamide N bears CH2-Bn and CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH-, the CH attached to C3 of a 2,5-dimethylpyrrole whose N1 is bonded to a 2,4-dimethylphenyl ring (circle; methyls ortho and para to the N attachment).
ref.notes: Typeset. Both benzene rings drawn with circles (verified by zoom; not Kekule); pyrrole uses two explicit C=C. Double bonds: two S=O, C=O, C=N, two pyrrole C=C. Four methyls are unlabelled line stubs.

wrong.substituent_description: Left benzene (circle) has S(=O)2 at the right vertex and AcNH at the lower-left vertex, i.e. meta (1,3) to each other. Sulfonamide N bears CH2-Bn and CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH- to C3 of a 2,5-dimethylpyrrole; pyrrole N bonded to a phenyl (circle) with methyls ortho and para to the N.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The n of Bn is written cursively and resembles an r
Thin dark-grey ink, some strokes faint
wrong.notes: Handwritten, dark grey/black pen. NH written as N over H. Double bonds: two S=O, C=O, C=N, two pyrrole C=C.

correct.substituent_description: Left benzene (circle) para-disubstituted with AcNH and S(=O)2. Sulfonamide N bears CH2-Bn and CH2-C(=O)-NH-N=CH- to C3 of a 2,5-dimethylpyrrole; pyrrole N bonded to a phenyl (circle) with methyls ortho and para to the N attachment.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: The n of Bn is written cursively
Right aryl ring sits near the image edge
correct.notes: Handwritten black pen. NH written as N over H. Same content as reference.

errors_in_wrong.description: On the left benzene ring the reference has AcNH para (1,4) to the sulfonyl S; the wrong drawing places AcNH on the lower-left vertex, meta (1,3) to the S-bearing carbon.

review_notes: Wrong drawing moves AcNH from para to meta relative to SO2 on the left benzene; everything else matches. Corrected drawing restores para and matches the reference. Cursive Bn in both handwritten copies is readable and not counted as an error.
